## About
Action Sales & Service is a family-owned and operated shop on Murphy Rd in Stafford. We sell new and used outdoor power equipment, fix small engines, and keep a deep stock of parts so your mower, trimmer or chainsaw gets back to work.
Our factory trained technicians work on the equipment people around here use every week, from push mowers to zero turn riders. We serve Stafford and neighbors in Missouri City, Sugar Land, Richmond, Katy and the rest of Fort Bend County and Southwest Houston. We are fully insured.
Customers rate us 4.4 on Google from 112 reviews. Stop by the shop or give us a call with your questions.

## Services
- New power equipment: Push and self-propelled mowers, riding mowers, Z-turns, tractors, line trimmers, edgers, blowers, chainsaws, tillers, generators, power washers and water pumps. We carry Scag, Toro and Echo.
- Used equipment: Pre-owned outdoor equipment, including used Scag Z-turns when we have them in stock.
- Service and repair: We work on push and self-propelled mowers, riding mowers, zero turn riders, garden tractors, line trimmers, edgers, blowers, chainsaws, hedge trimmers and tillers, plus the engines on generators, power washers and water pumps. If yours isn't on the list, call or email us.
- Parts: OEM and aftermarket parts for brands including Toro, Snapper, Scag, Echo, Stihl, Shindaiwa, RedMax, Briggs and Stratton, Kohler, Kawasaki, Honda, Billy Goat, Bear Cat, EGO and Subaru.

## FAQ
Q: Do you guarantee your work?
A: Yes. We provide a 30-day guarantee on all service work and on used equipment.

Q: How can I pay?
A: We accept cash, credit and debit cards. For security reasons, we don't take payment over the phone.

Q: Do you repair generators and power washers?
A: Yes, we service the engines on generators, power washers and water pumps.
